# Racing-style number wording, 0..999. THE shared contract between
# SpotterPhrase::numberWords (C++) and spottergen's num_words (the
# pack baker): asserted by test_spotter_phrase.cpp and the
# spottergen-selftest gate, so the two sides can only pass together.
# A deliberate wording change regenerates this file AND every pack.
